auditId.description: Server-generated primary key (audit-<12 random digits>); never sent by the client.

entityId.description: Primary key of the catalogue record this audit row is about (e.g. cropVariety-000000000777).

entityName.description: Catalogue the record belongs to (e.g. cropType, cropVariety). Free string; catalogues grow over time.

userId.description: Stable id of the actor who performed this action.

userName.description: Display name of the actor (denormalised; derivable from userId).

userRole.description: Governance level of the actor. L0 = maker, L1 = checker, L2 = publisher/authority.

operation.description: Lifecycle action performed, mapping to the source catalogue endpoints: CREATE (full create), DRAFT (partial entry), SUBMIT (promote a draft), APPROVE (L1 review), REVIEW (L2 publish), TOGGLE (activate/deactivate), UPDATE, DELETE.

auditStatus.description: Resulting lifecycle state recorded by this immutable row. Matches the source catalogue's status values exactly (UPPERCASE).

changeRequestId.description: Optional correlation id grouping the L0/L1/L2 rows of one change-request. Populated by the emitter if available.

entityBeforeChanges.description: State BEFORE this action. Empty object {} for a CREATE; populated for an UPDATE.

entityAfterChanges.description: State AFTER this action (the resulting record or the changed fields).

createdOn.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the action occurred (UTC 'Z' recommended). Sort/range key.

updatedOn.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; equals createdOn at write time for an immutable audit row.
